figuren.prompt_auszug: FEMALE-READ EMERGENCY PHYSICIAN. Tall broad pear blob with one hooked crown loop, tiny plain ivory hairband, short dark clay side curl and subtle lashes. Small teal collar, two short ivory coat lapels. Focused urgent resolve: one huge WHITE eye forward and other sharply squinting, one high/one low brow, shallow crooked clenched mouth with three uneven teeth, heavy lower lip. Holds ONE SIMPLE STETHOSCOPE low in one hand: two short metal ear tubes with rounded ear tips join one obvious Y-shaped black flexible tube leading to ONE round silver chest disc, no disconnected loops or impossible branches. Other hand holds ONE small plain triage CLIPBOARD with THREE bold colored edge tabs and blank cream paper, no writing. Entire device and board inside cell.
